svg.title: Pact roadmap: build trust, then broaden capability
svg.desc: Seven staged roadmap steps: define contracts and baselines; secure native execution and tools; compare memory and programming models; grow the language; add agent-facing compiler operations; build reliable workflows; and evaluate on held-out tasks.
svg.text: Correct outcomes, secure execution, and speed are co-equal release gates.

text.tspan: Make agent-written programs dependable across broad workloads; make no speed claim until measured.

g.text: FOUNDATION
Define contracts and baselines
Version the JSON AST and diagnostics. Pilot generation, editing, and repair;
compare with Rust, Python, and strict TypeScript on matched tasks and tools.
TRUST BOUNDARY · FIRST
Secure execution and tools
Bubblewrap namespaces + cgroup v2. Deny network and host files; bound
CPU, memory, processes, time, scratch, and output. Fail closed. Put tools
and credentials in a host broker; begin with mock math.double.
CONTROLLED EXPERIMENTS
Compare memory and code styles
Test ownership, bounded arenas, and managed heap; compare procedural,
record/function, and class/method styles. Measure safety, memory, speed,
compile time, and repair burden. Keep the simplest candidate that clears gates.
LANGUAGE
Add data and control flow
Strings, arrays, records, tagged unions, functions, branches, and bounded
iteration—with explicit overflow, bounds, recursion, and allocation rules.
AGENT INTERFACE
Make compiler edits reliable
Versioned JSON check, inspect, and edit operations; stable node identities,
revisions, source locations, and atomic rejection of stale or invalid edits.
WORKFLOWS
Handle failures and resumption
Host-owned SQLite checkpoints, explicit timeout/cancellation outcomes,
safe retries only for declared idempotent tools; then bounded parallelism.
HELD-OUT EVALUATION
Measure, tune, and report
Freeze 96 tasks; 3 pinned model configurations across 2 families;
3 samples per task. Match tools, docs, budgets, hardware, and sandbox.
Report paired uncertainty, failures, native runtime, and end-to-end time.

svg.text: Stages sequence evidence and risk reduction; they make no delivery-date or performance promise.
